pm_enabled.checkpoint: before keeper surplus computation and settle

vault_has_l1_position.checkpoint: before keeper surplus computation and settle

auto_borrow_occurred.meaning: an adverse price movement triggered a PM auto-borrow producing a nonzero 0x811 borrow.value on the Vault's L1 account
auto_borrow_occurred.checkpoint: before keeper surplus computation and settle

settle_accepted_unbacked_yield.meaning: settle accepted a proposedYield that exceeds the true distributable surplus (phantom surplus passed Gate 3 and Gate 4)

claims.scope: Vault surplus accounting and yield settlement via MonetrixAccountant._readL1Backing and vault.settle

preconditions.text: Portfolio Margin is activated on the Vault's L1 account.; The Vault holds a hedge or spot position on L1.; An adverse price movement triggers a PM auto-borrow on the Vault's L1 account, producing a nonzero 0x811 borrow.value.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Distributed yield must not exceed real surplus: settle must reject proposedYield above the true distributable surplus (INV-7, INV-9).
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Phantom surplus passes Gate 3 and settle accepts unbacked yield, violating INV-7 and INV-9.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The keeper proposes yield up to the reported phantom surplus and calls vault.settle(proposedYield).
The reported phantom surplus is derived from totalBackingSigned() which omits the borrow.value subtraction.
Gate 3 and Gate 4 are the settle checks that are supposed to cap proposedYield at true distributable surplus.

limitations: The claim formalizes only the phantom_surplus_passes_gate impact; principal displacement and backing overstatement are handled in separate passes.
The true distributable surplus quantity is not numerically defined in the report, so the relation is a Boolean forbidding acceptance of unbacked yield rather than a numeric inequality.
Whether Gate 4 annualized cap is satisfied for a given proposedYield is not quantified.
